title: primitive 변환이 없는 패스의 lookahead 순회 생략
existingWork: preconvertMetal4Draws에서 최대2048 command plan 순회가 남아 있음.
missingEvidence: 첫 pipeline이나 첫 draw만으로 생략할 수 없고 실제 불필요 순회 빈도 미확정.
requiredBoundary: 일반 패스 전체의 no-conversion 증명이 필요. fan/restart/dynamic topology/provoking/shader write/unknown command 예외 유지.

risk.function: 높음: 뒤의 fan/restart/provoking/dynamic topology/inherited state/unknown·shader write를 첫 pipeline만으로 배제 불가.
risk.lifetime: 중간: plan은 command/pipeline/index 상태와 command 수명에 연결.
risk.synchronization: 중간~높음: prepass producer/handoff와 local/queue barrier 유지.
risk.memory: 보수적 요약 bit는 작을 수 있으나 per-command 상태/plan을 추가 보관하면 비용이 큼.

strategy: Attach a conservative no-conversion summary to an already recorded pass interval only if the existing capture path can produce it cheaply. Any unknown/dynamic topology, fan, restart, provoking requirement, shader write or inherited uncertainty selects the original full planner.
acceptance: Existing evidence shows meaningful negative lookahead scanning
All commands in the exact interval are covered; first pipeline/draw alone is never proof
Summary construction cost does not simply duplicate the skipped scan
tests: Existing primitive-plan/native cases with baseline planner as oracle
Dynamic topology, secondary/inherited state and unknown command force fallback; producer/handoff barriers unchanged
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
